title: New Harmony Clay Project Ceramics Residency
cost_text: No direct costs; travel and per diem are resident's responsibility.
source_quote: The program is offered from September-April of each year. Residents have the opportunity to select a flexible residency time frame that accommodates their schedules-from one up to eight month periods.
evidence_sentence: The residency page lists a raku kiln and salt kiln available to resident artists in the studio equipment.
evidence_quote: Two Gas Kilns including a Salt Kiln and Raku Kiln
summary: A September–April residency for emerging and professional ceramic artists, with access to raku and salt kilns. Requires B.F.A. or B.A./B.S. with professional experience, full-time studio commitment, and 1–8 month terms. Housing and monthly stipend provided; no program fees.
